title: CY50102: Physical Chemistry Of Surfaces
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: NilSurface Tension and surface energy; measurement of surface
tension; nature and thermodynamics of liquid surfaces; surface films on liquid
surfaces; electrical aspects of surface chemistry; long-range forces; surfaces
of solids; physico-chemical methods of surface and interface analysis; solidliquid interfaces â contact angle; solid-liquid interface â adsorption from
solution; friction, lubrication, and adhesion; wetting, flotation, and
detergency; emulsions, foams, aerosols; solid-gas interface â general
considerations, adsorption of gases and vapors on solids, chemisorption and
catalysis.Books: A.W. Adamson and A. P. Gast, Physical Chemistry of Surfaces,
Wiley Interscience; 6 edition, 1997; J. C. Vickerman, Surface Analysis - The
Principal Techniques, Wiley-Interscience, 6 edition, 1997; G. A. Somorjai
Introduction to Surface Chemistry and Catalysis, Wiley-Interscience, 1994; E.M.
McCash, Surface Chemistry, Oxford University Press, USA; 2001.
